# Vertiv (VRT) Liquid Cooling Brief

**Date:** 2026-11-12  
**Author:** Industrial & Power Desk  
**Source Type:** Analyst Report

## Facts & Catalysts
- Vertiv reported organic orders up 37% YoY with backlog reaching a record $7.4B, led by liquid cooling CDUs and high-density UPS systems.
- Upcoming Investor Day in December is expected to raise long-term operating margin targets.

## View
- **Stance:** Buy (high conviction, strong support).
- Vertiv directly benefits from the **AI Data Center Power Bottleneck** theme as rack power density doubles from Hopper to Blackwell architectures.
- Vertiv competes directly with Schneider Electric and legacy air-cooling vendors such as Carrier's commercial HVAC unit.
